pairs.premise: Grafana dashboards were served from the standalone monitoring VM from April 2025 until the October 2025 move onto the k3s cluster.
pairs.hypothesis: Grafana dashboards were still served from the standalone monitoring VM in August 2025.
pairs.rationale: August 2025 lies inside the stated validity window [April 2025, October 2025). A claim time-scoped inside the window is entailed (window rule).

pairs.premise: Since the May 2026 cutover, LAN DNS has been handled by the pair of AdGuard Home instances.
pairs.hypothesis: As of September 2026, AdGuard Home handles DNS for the LAN.
pairs.rationale: Open-window rule: a state valid since May 2026 with no closing event named entails the same state at any later reference date, including September 2026.

pairs.premise: The nightly backup job has run at 02:00 UTC since it was rescheduled in March 2026; before that it ran at 04:00 UTC.
pairs.hypothesis: In July 2026 the nightly backup job ran at 02:00 UTC.
pairs.rationale: The 02:00 window opens in March 2026 and no closing event is named, so the state holds at the later reference date July 2026 (open-window rule).

pairs.premise: Traefik was the ingress controller from June 2025 until the February 2026 switch to nginx-ingress.
pairs.hypothesis: Traefik is currently the ingress controller.
pairs.rationale: The window is explicitly closed by a named end event and successor (the February 2026 switch to nginx-ingress); a present-tense claim over an explicitly closed window is contradicted (window rule).

pairs.premise: The team wiki ran on DokuWiki until its November 2025 migration to BookStack.
pairs.hypothesis: The team wiki was still running on DokuWiki in January 2026.
pairs.rationale: The DokuWiki window is explicitly closed by the November 2025 migration to a named successor, and January 2026 lies after that close; a claim time-scoped past an explicitly closed window is contradicted (window rule).

pairs.premise: API tokens minted by the setup wizard expire 30 days after issue; the admin token was minted on 5 June 2026.
pairs.hypothesis: The admin token is currently valid.
pairs.rationale: Whether the token is valid "currently" depends on an evaluation date the premise does not contain: a 30-day lifetime and an unanchored "currently" leave the claim undecidable, so it is unsupported (evaluation-time rule).

pairs.premise: Automatic package upgrades were paused during the Q2 2026 storage rebuild.
pairs.hypothesis: Automatic package upgrades have been re-enabled.
pairs.rationale: "Paused during Q2 2026" implicates the pause ended but does not assert re-enablement; conversational implicature moves no verdict, and absence is not exclusion (implicature-is-not-contradiction rule; general procedure 4).

pairs.premise: Since the January 2026 rollout, host metrics have been scraped by VictoriaMetrics.
pairs.hypothesis: VictoriaMetrics was scraping host metrics in November 2025.
pairs.rationale: The stated window opens in January 2026 and the claim is scoped before it; the premise asserts nothing about the earlier period, and the implicature that scraping began only at the rollout is not asserted content (general procedure 4 — absence is not exclusion; implicature-is-not-contradiction rule).

pairs.premise: The rack's UPS batteries were replaced in August 2025 and are rated for a three-year service life.
pairs.hypothesis: The UPS batteries are currently within their rated service life.
pairs.rationale: The claim's truth turns on an evaluation date the premise does not fix — a three-year life from August 2025 against an unanchored "currently" — so it is undecidable from the premise alone (evaluation-time rule).
